title: Kissed Salty Chinese Ferment Bao
description: This Zhejiang dish is a classic example of monsoon-inspired fermented Chinese cuisine, featuring a salty and chewy texture.

ingredients.name: Active dry yeast
ingredients.notes: Instant yeast is not recommended for fermentation processes

instructions: Combine fermented rice flour, salt, and yeast in a large mixing bowl. Knead dough for 10 minutes until elastic and smooth.
Place dough in a greased bowl, cover with plastic wrap, and let ferment in a warm, draft-free area for 24 hours.
Punch down dough, then mix in mung bean paste and water until a smooth batter forms.
Heat 1 cup of water in a medium saucepan over medium heat until it reaches 180°F.
Using a piping bag or a plastic squeeze bottle, pipe dough mixture into small circles.
Place each bao in the saucepan and cook for 3-5 minutes on each side, until golden brown and puffed.
Brush bao with sesame oil and garnish with chopped scallions if desired.
